item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. It's a quiet fact that most of us start the day a little dry, and that shows up as lower focus and a shorter fuse. Your day has plenty of pauses built in, including meditation, a walk, and some wind-down time. Use them. Tie water to those moments instead of relying on memory. Your action: before you do anything else this morning, drink a full glass of water.
